📖 How to use

  1. Fill in any one measurement: inner circumference (mm), inner diameter (mm) or US size.
  2. Read the matching US, UK, EU/ISO and Japanese sizes instantly.
  3. Measure circumference with a strip of paper around the finger for best accuracy.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How accurate is the US size formula?

US size ≈ (circumference in mm − 36.9) ÷ 2.5, which matches standard charts within a quarter size. Brands vary slightly, so treat it as a guide.

What is EU / ISO ring size?

The ISO standard: ring size equals the inner circumference in millimeters (e.g. 52 = 52 mm around).

Should I measure in the morning or evening?

Measure at the end of the day when fingers are largest, and measure 3-4 times for consistency.
